instruction: Pull over near the car on the right side of the intersection.
paraphrases: Stop by the car on the right at the junction.|Park near the right-hand car at the intersection.

instruction: Stop near the pedestrian on the left at the crossing.
paraphrases: Pull over by the left pedestrian at the crosswalk.|Park near the left-hand pedestrian crossing.

instruction: Park near the white car turning on the left.
paraphrases: Stop by the left-turning white car.|Pull over near the white car on the left.

instruction: Pass the large vehicle on the left, then stop near the car ahead.
paraphrases: Go past the large vehicle on the left and stop by the car in front.|After the large left vehicle, pull over near the car ahead.
What car is in front?|Identify the car ahead of us.

instruction: Take the car on the right—correction, take the car on the left.
paraphrases: The right car—rather, the left one.|Choose the left car, not the right car.

instruction: Pass the partially visible car on the right, then stop near the car ahead.
paraphrases: Go past the partly visible right car and stop by the car in front.|After the occluded car on the right, pull over near the car ahead.

instruction: Pass the large vehicle on the left, then stop near the car ahead on the right.
paraphrases: Go past the large left vehicle and stop by the right car ahead.|After the large vehicle, pull over near the car on the right.

instruction: Pull over near the pedestrian on the right.
paraphrases: Stop beside the right-hand pedestrian.|Park by the pedestrian on the right.

instruction: Stop near the car on the far left, not the one in the middle.
paraphrases: Take the far-left car rather than the middle car.|Pull over by the leftmost car, not the central one.
